List deliveries, newest first, across webhooks or of one, with how the webhook answered. --failed
shows only failures. It reads the newest 100 deliveries of each webhook.

Usage:
  voidhash webhook deliveries [webhook] [flags]

Arguments:
  webhook  Only this webhook's deliveries: its name, URL or id (default: all)

Flags:
      --failed             Only deliveries that failed or gave up
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --limit <limit>      How many to show, newest first, at most 100
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash webhook deliveries
  voidhash webhook deliveries "Orders backend" --failed
  voidhash webhook deliveries --failed -q
